columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number, kept as text. A leading C marks a cancellation invoice; see is_cancellation.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and VARCHAR type.

columns.name: is_cancellation
columns.description: True when invoice_id carries the C cancellation prefix. Cancellations are retained and flagged, not dropped, so conservation arithmetic against bronze stays auditable.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and BOOLEAN type.

columns.name: stock_code
columns.description: Product code as landed, kept as text; alphanumeric suffixes and non-product adjustment codes (for example POST, M) occur.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and VARCHAR type.

columns.name: product_description
columns.description: Product description, whitespace-trimmed; nulls retained rather than imputed.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile measures a nonzero null_rate (0.005098), consistent with required false.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Units on the line. Negative values occur both on cancellation-invoice lines and on zero-unit-price stock-adjustment lines; consumers must not infer cancellation from negative quantity alone.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and INTEGER type.

columns.name: invoiced_at
columns.description: Invoice timestamp, strictly cast; an unparseable value fails the build loudly rather than becoming a silent null. On within-invoice clock-drift duplicates the earliest scan tick wins.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and TIMESTAMP type.

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Unit price in sterling. Zero-price lines (freebies and adjustments) are retained; negative prices are contract-invalid.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0, min 0.0, max 1998.49, matching DECIMAL(10,2).

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier. The bronze null rate is retained as null (guest or unregistered checkouts), not dropped and not imputed.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile measures null_rate 0.300664, consistent with required false.

columns.name: country
columns.rationale: Unchanged from committed contract; profile confirms null_rate 0.0 and 24 distinct values.

columns.name: captured_at
columns.description: Capture timestamp carried forward from the bronze landing: records when the surviving line's earliest capture entered the pipeline. Serves as the incremental watermark the gold layer builds on. Required now that the incremental capture path is live and the column is fully populated for every surviving row.
columns.rationale: Profile measures null_rate 0.0 for captured_at over 44,721 rows, satisfying the committed F-28 follow-up condition that the column be proven fully populated before tightening to required.

purpose: The cleaned, typed, one-row-per-invoice-line view of the Online Retail II sample: the first contracted silver table and the sole silver input to the gold unified event star.
usage: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level retail sales analysis. Cancellation lines are retained and flagged (is_cancellation); consumers aggregating revenue must filter or net them deliberately. Zero-price lines are retained.
limitations: Exact duplicate bronze rows are treated as capture artifacts and excluded, so identical legitimate re-scans are indistinguishable and also excluded; the residual grain is the distinct line. Rows identical in every business column except invoicedate are the same capture artifact seen across a register clock tick; they collapse to one line and the earliest timestamp is retained. customer_id is null for guest or unregistered checkouts; those rows are retained with customer_id null.
